limits: Official package identity/SRI/license/tag and two source-map content matches do not establish the target installed lock, unmodified package or whole implementation equivalence.
Role projection deliberately preserves external SDK identifier versus literal reads; no unproved bundler normalization/constant folding.
Complete selected function formals/simple direct locals were checked; original complete outer bindings, lazy initialization order, aliases/later writes and runtime values remain unknown.
Global truthy .version preservation is a static operation, not an observed active version; singleton helper does not assign .version.
No caller, frontend SDK package, full factory/dependency closure, application initialization adapter, mode ownership or feature deletion conclusion.

Target and official package implementations were not executed. Static semantic reading/parsing was limited to saved bounded target functions/neighborhoods/initializer spans and selected official modules/metadata; initial selection read bounded original target bytes and hashed the three original files for integrity without whole-program parsing. Native/UI/model/profile/auth/history contents were not read or used. Earlier filename-only path inventory did not open runtime user-data contents.
